lessons.claim: The dilute->semi-dilute transition of a rod suspension is n L^3 = O(1) on the theoretical scale, but experimentally it happens at 10~50 and the conventional value is 30 (Maguire 1980, Mori 1982, Zero-Pecora 1982). ★ When putting it in a check it has to be a warning (!) rather than a hard failure (X). The width of the semi-dilute window is set by the aspect ratio: O(1) << n L^3 << L/a = 2r. The excluded volume of a pair of orthogonal rods is 2 a L^2 (an L x L x 2a parallelepiped, with a sin theta angular dependence)
